purpose: Publish the base attack distance for final Hero jobs by exact JobID so Hero frontend can render attack range without reading raw ConfigData or deriving job semantics.

selection.normalFinalJobs: For each Stage 6 shard, take the last explicit jobConnectionId of each normal.jobTree.branches entry; resolve that exact connection and admit it only when job.rank == 4.
selection.releasedSpFinalJobs: When shard.sp.status == RELEASED, use shard.sp.job.jobId exactly.
selection.join: Exact numeric final-job jobId == ConfigDataJobInfo.ID only.

boundaries.attackDistanceMeaning: Copy the explicit ConfigDataJobInfo.BF_AttackDistance value for the exact JobID; do not infer skill-modified or conditional battle range.

completionCriteria: Every current Stage 6 normal rank-4 branch capstone JobID resolves exactly once in ConfigDataJobInfo.ID.
Every current RELEASED SP jobId resolves exactly once in ConfigDataJobInfo.ID.
Every admitted JobID has a positive integer BF_AttackDistance.
Generated byJobId keys exactly equal the current Stage 6 final-job JobID set.
Independent validator reports zero missing, duplicate, invalid-range, or parity mismatches.
No paths outside the declared producer outputs are mutated by producer execution.
resumeEvidence: The validation output is the owned completion and resume evidence for this unit; no separate checkpoint path is required.
nextScope: After this consumer is frozen, hero-frontend may read it by exact final-job JobID and render the base attack range.
